title: #102 Life Experience
prompt: Some people argue that experience is the best teacher, saying life experiences teach people more effectively than books or formal education can. How far do you agree with this statement? Give your reason or provide your personal experience.

promptSegments.text: Some people argue that experience is the best teacher, saying life experiences teach people more effectively than books or formal education can.
How far do you agree with this statement?
Give your reason or provide your personal experience.
